_what: Consolidated census values. Every number carries a STATUS -- a bare count cannot distinguish a real zero from a lookup that asked the wrong place, and this census produced both.

_status_meanings.MEASURED: counted, lookup verified to have reached the right place
_status_meanings.MEASURED_ZERO: none exist; the lookup reached where they live
_status_meanings.UNVERIFIED: value came from a lookup later found broken, and the source project has been deleted, so it cannot be re-run
_status_meanings.NOT_CAPTURED: the accessor failed; no value exists
_status_meanings.ZERO_UNAUDITED: zero, with no trace proving the lookup landed
_status_meanings.BLOCKED: the project could not be opened
